name: Condottieri Guards
headerMeta: Silver era · Melee Infantry (shields) · 160 leadership · T3 mastery
pitch: A cost-effective shielded melee line with charge-into-skill combo damage and surprising reach for newer players. Keep them mobile — their weakness is sustained pressure and pike formations they can't break through.

doctrines.name: Damage-reduction doctrine
doctrines.note: −5% DMG taken, alternative for LDS or free slot

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Boosts the primary damage tool (Shock Attack/Shock Shieldbash): +5% movement, +8% critical, +30% skill damage, +3s duration, −3s cooldown — cuts effective downtime from 18s to 9s. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Exploit the unit's speed for lateral repositioning and flanking — reposition unseen, hit targets from the rear or sides for bonus flank damage. {2} Spread into loose formation vs tight shield walls (e.g. Imperial Spears) — route the charge around the line, envelop from the side, and stagger-lock with Shock Attack. {2}
battleRole.tips: Alternative engagement order: move/flank first, press Shock Attack, then charge into melee once in position — lets you hit backline/high-value targets from behind. {2} Even without an open flank route, walking the sides of a fight instead of charging straight at the center usually nets bonus flank damage. {2} Cost-effective unit: sacrificing Condottieri Guards to secure map control or an objective trade is often a net win given the 175 leadership cost. {2}

cards.name: Fortebraccio Pikemen
cards.why: braced pike formation eats unsupported charges; breaks only with CC support.

cards.name: Imperial Spears
cards.why: tight shield-wall formation — head-on charge yields little; requires flank spread-and-envelop.

controls.notes: Primary combo: charge launches the Shock Shieldbash after it; {1} Shock Attack (press 2) is your main DPS spell. {1} Cost-effective: with low leadership, sacrificing the unit to secure map/objective trades (175 leadership for 700 leadership's enemy value) is a clear net win. {2}
